messages:
Maria Gomez: Quick heads-up — Acme launch on May 12. We need to lock SI co-sell handoff & account mapping for marketplace announcement. Primary Q: who owns inbound leads from marketplace trial signups? Demo credits and credit burn policy?

Ajay Patel: My take: marketplace leads go to SI until they request Redwood-managed POC. Default ownership: SI owns first 7 days, we own after 7 days if not engaged. Thoughts? :thinking:

Jen Lee: That aligns w/ what we discussed on call. Need CRM tags + lead_source values. Suggest tag: marketplace_acme_si and si_owner_id.

Luke Robinson: +1. Also recommend a 'handoff_window' field in SFDC: 7d_default, and a custom SLA task created at +48h for SI to confirm contact. If not confirmed -> auto-reassign to Redwood AE.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Link to draft playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/si-acme-marketplace-playbook (draft) :link:

Maria Gomez: Can we add an exception for high-intent leads (trial usage > 50% of quota) — SI keeps unless they opt-out?

Ajay Patel: Yes — rule: if trial_usage_pct >= 50 then do not auto-reassign. Will add to mapping.

Jen Lee: CRM snippet I propose:
```
lead_source = "marketplace_acme"
si_owner = "<SI Company ID>"
handoff_deadline = created_at + 7d
escalation_task = created_at + 48h if si_owner_confirmed == false
high_intent_flag = trial_usage_pct >= 50
```
Use automation to set tags.

Luke Robinson: Who will own the routing automation? We can add to Marketplace Ops backlog but need an owner for Q3 launch.

Maria Gomez: @Ajay can you own routing automations? @Jen will you update the playbook and share final confluence page by EOD Friday?

Ajay Patel: I can own basic automation. Will scope today and post Jira. :white_check_mark:

Jen Lee: I’ll update playbook and add sample SFDC field mappings + sample dashboard for SI performance.

Marketplace Ops Bot: Created task REDWOOD-2314: implement-marketplace-routing (assignee: Ajay Patel) — https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/REDWOOD-2314

Maria Gomez: Great. One more: announcement messaging — need joint email template and a 1-pager for SI to share. @Luke pls own the 1-pager?

Luke Robinson: I’ll draft the 1-pager and drop in the playbook. ETA Wed.

Maria Gomez: Thanks team — syncing with marketing to align announcement cadence. Will post final timeline here when I have it. :rocket:
